timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Ben Carter and I'm standing for two main reasons. The reasons why I joined
the Green Party a few years back then. Inclusivity and connection. No matter how much you read
or hear in the media about how different we are or listen to extremists and device of politicians
and telling us how we have to reject the other and reject each other, the homeless,
refugees. We're all the same. We share the same humanity, the same experience, but we're
also connected to the planet. This is our home and if we don't look after it, no one else will.
So the reason why I'm standing on the 4th of May for the University Parks Division is to take
those core principles forward and try and make a better Oxfordshire and work with the people of
Oxfordshire to make a better planet.
